indicator_definition: GDP divided by domestic material consumption (DMC), expressed in euros per kilogram. Higher resource productivity means more economic output per unit of material. Data compiled by Eurostat from material flow accounts.
rationale: Improving resource productivity decouples growth from material use and reduces environmental pressures. Progress means a sustained increase in resource productivity.
methodology_characteristics: Calculated using GDP and domestic material consumption from material flow accounts (MFA). Both indicators compiled under the EU material flow accounts framework. Published annually.
